descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S29 A failure on a chart that already has a note: today's note survives a failed Regenerate, and yesterday's note never shows as today's (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given (a) Local stack; in each context a chart ({hospitalPatient}, {snfResident}) whose note N1 was generated today with the seam off. (b) A second Hospital patient ({hospitalPatient2}, Follow-up) and a second Nursing Home resident ({snfResident2}) with yesterday's note seeded (the previous note 3.6 keeps for 36 h; …

When (a) Append 'QA OAT-03 regenerate line: plan unchanged.' to the encounter dictation, put both models into failure (the S11 seam), tap Generate Note & Finish again. (b) Fail today's first Generate the same way, then open Post-Round

Then (a) An explicit failure; the dictation, including the appended line, is kept; the stored note still equals N1, or the app says plainly that N1 was replaced. (b) Post-Round does not show yesterday's note under today's heading: it is labelled as the previous note or carries its date

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): (a) Encounter checkpoint mustContain the appended line and 'couldn’t be generated'; Post-Round shows N1. Backend: rounding:get / snf:get note equals N1 exactly; if it does not, the failure copy must say N1 was replaced (recorded for Q3). (b) Post-Round shows the marker sentence only together with 'previous note' or yesterday's date in the same view; …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S29 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: probes.

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S29

A failure on a chart that already has a note: today's note survives a failed Regenerate, and yesterday's note never shows as today's (both contexts)

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane probes: status blocked in probes/results.json → blocked (blocked).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: partly): Scripted probe: leg 1 LIVE Generate N1 on a Hospital chart and an NH chart; leg 2 (a) append a line, generateNote failed at the socket, Regenerate: explicit failure, appended line kept + stored, stored note == N1, Post-Round still shows N1; (b) charts seeded with yesterday's note (Hospital previousNotes, NH note 20 h old), today's first Generate fails: yesterday's marker must not sit under today's note heading, today's note field not holding it, kept as previous. — Failure injected at the client socket (shared backend has no fault seam); all outcomes in the oracle are UI / stored-row checks and are judged.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given puts it on the local stack: the both-models-fail seam of S11 (fault-ai) is switched on between leg 1 and leg 2, which nothing on dev may do (no env change, no action mock; runner-contract §10)..
